research_questions.title: Structured reconstruction
research_questions.question: Can a general-purpose reasoning agent transform coarse photogrammetric geometry, images, and records into an editable component-level scene with reusable equipment families?

research_questions.title: Verifier-bounded reliability
research_questions.question: Can deterministic validation expose invalid geometry and force explicit protocol or abstraction revisions rather than silent acceptance?

research_questions.title: Coverage-driven completion
research_questions.question: Can residual and occupancy audits identify omissions that inventory-driven completion misses?

research_questions.title: Human-steerable correction
research_questions.question: Can sparse human spatial feedback be converted into traceable 3D corrections without requiring vertex-level manual modeling?

research_questions.title: Inspection semantics
research_questions.question: Can stabilized/reused geometry be augmented with inspection-addressable parts while preserving the earlier geometry history?

evidence_sources.name: Registered photogrammetric coarse mesh
evidence_sources.role: layout, occupied-region discovery, local reference surfaces
evidence_sources.limit: not independent truth for residuals computed against the same mesh

evidence_sources.name: UAV and ground photographs
evidence_sources.scale: 775 identity-photo candidates in the early queue; additional audit imagery exists
evidence_sources.role: visible component form, count, order, materials and qualitative alignment
evidence_sources.limit: not definitive nameplate identity; calibration incomplete in several stages

evidence_sources.name: Equipment and semantic records
evidence_sources.role: inventory, codes, semantic expectations and inspection concepts
evidence_sources.limit: inventory presence does not prove geometry completion

evidence_sources.name: Human review and persistent history
evidence_sources.scale: batch notes, failed drafts, review markup and continuation records
evidence_sources.role: equivalence authorization, omission discovery, error correction and external memory
evidence_sources.limit: human intervention is part of the method

core_metrics.name: Reference-surface residual ledger
core_metrics.definition: nearest/reference-surface distances summarized across retained batch validation records
core_metrics.interpretation: internal agreement with the same photogrammetric reference

core_metrics.name: 5 cm screen
core_metrics.definition: retained screening items below/above the selected 5 cm criterion
core_metrics.not: task success rate or overall accuracy

core_metrics.name: Coverage gap fraction
core_metrics.definition: fraction of selected high-region coarse samples more than 1 m from the reconstructed scene

core_metrics.name: Reuse ratio
core_metrics.definition: scene objects divided by mesh datablocks

core_metrics.name: Inspection-point categorization
core_metrics.definition: official transformer inspection points categorized into model-part, external-component, and non-visual classes

version_boundary.D38.2: core geometry baseline after markup-driven correction
version_boundary.D40: material-only layer with geometry/transform invariance validation
version_boundary.D41: inspection-semantic transformer accessory augmentation; research endpoint

key_cases.diagnosis: comparison domain mixed shaft with protruding accessories
key_cases.lesson: verifier design is part of the research object

key_cases.trigger: neighbor contamination and overextended shared bus spool
key_cases.diagnosis: measurement and abstraction boundary were wrong
key_cases.change: revise measurement; move site-specific segments out of shared master

key_cases.trigger: human top-view review found omitted low bus racks
key_cases.diagnosis: earlier batch logic explicitly excluded a needed independent device
key_cases.lesson: small human feedback can redirect substantial agentic work

key_cases.trigger: user markup identified false cabinets, GIS gaps and a missing fire room
key_cases.diagnosis: proxy placement and orientation semantics were wrong
key_cases.change: register markup, quarantine false objects, rebuild gaps, correct yaw semantics
key_cases.lesson: traceable correction is preferable to silent deletion

key_cases.trigger: isolated renders and photographs exposed naming-based mapping mistakes
key_cases.diagnosis: string/box matching confused bus tubes, GIS components, arresters and switches
key_cases.change: structured device-family rules and explicit missing-geometry labels
key_cases.lesson: semantic attachment needs the same validation discipline as geometry
